summary: Add private test-only qualification of canonical message point reads; share unchanged recipient predicates and reminder-rank parsing with existing mailbox readers.

replay.detail: No replay implementation, startup work or projection reconstruction changes. The new point capture and its controls are compiled only in tests.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema version, installer, registration, retention or writer hooks are added. Storage remains at the chosen baseline.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digest inputs, replication admission or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: No public route, error code, scope, cursor, client schema, provider contract or message membership promise changes. Runtime extraction preserves the existing recipient SQL predicates and first reminder/version parsing; equivalence is subject to required hosted qualification.

downtime.detail: No new runtime initialization, background work or service-interruption requirement; no restart or performance observations are claimed.

manual.detail: No new operator or user steps. Qualification limits apply only to the test-only helper and do not refuse production messages.

recovery.detail: No persisted state or migration is introduced by this change, so it adds no recovery or rollback procedure beyond the chosen baseline.
